budget.billing_note: Token Plan usage is paid or quota-limited; stop before speculative exploration.

prompt: Audit the current Kolibri frontend as an Agent Ops SaaS product. Do not modify files. Identify the smallest high-impact UI changes needed to make agents, servers, tasks, reports, risks, and degraded states clear for daily operations. Return evidence-backed findings only.

quality_contract.objective: Create a reviewable UX audit for turning Kolibri frontend into an operational agent console.
quality_contract.context: Codex has selected an Agent Ops SaaS direction; Claw should provide focused evidence before mutation work.
scope: Inspect existing frontend navigation, layout, states, and data surfaces.
Recommend a bounded backlog for Overview, Agents, Tasks, Servers, Reports, Chat, Docs, and Search.
Call out missing data contracts that need mock, offline, or degraded UI handling.
out_of_scope: Do not edit files or install packages.
Do not read secrets, auth files, .env files, .ssh, or .mimocode.
Do not deploy, restart services, purchase servers, or change HostVDS state.
acceptance_criteria: Return a prioritized UX backlog with no more than eight items.
Identify exact screens and states that need browser QA evidence.
State blockers separately from polish recommendations.
verification_steps: Inspect frontend source and available package scripts.
Report whether lint/build/browser QA can run in the target worktree.
deliverables: Structured result with status, summary, changed_files, checks, risks, and artifacts.
stop_conditions: Stop if credentials, tokens, private keys, or auth file contents are required.
Stop if evidence requires writing outside allowed_paths.
